programme.title: A Carol Christmas
programme.desc: Carol Cartman is a conceited sensationalist talk show host. She is cynical, selfish, and generally treats her employees with cold contempt. She has been coached by her late Aunt Marla to behave this way.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Mystery with Lea Thompson. When a ruthless arms dealer stages a prison escape, Jane Doe and NSA chief Frank Darnell quickly realise that a plot for deadly revenge lies behind it.

programme.title: Hidden Places
programme.desc: When Eliza (Sydney Penny) loses her father-in-law she is left to raise two children, continue work on an unharvested orange crop, and maintain a heavy mortgage. She begins to lose faith until her Aunt Batty (Shirley Jones) persuades her to persevere. Suddenly a mysterious stranger called Gabe (Jason Gedrick) turns up and helps Eliza with the harvest just in time to stop the bank from taking over. The more Eliza learns about Gabe, the more she realizes she loves him.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: Answered by Fire
programme.desc: Canadian RCMP officer Zoe Brennan, Australian Federal Policeman Mark Waldman and a young East Timorese translator named Ismenio Soares are brought together by the UN's fateful effort to give the Timorese a voice in their own future. In the chaotic run-up to the vote, these initially reluctant partners become real friends. But when the UN evacuates in the post-ballot rampage, Mark and Zoe are forced to abandon Ismenio and his family to a nightmarish fate. Haunted by guilt, the two westerners each find their way back to Timor, driven to make amends to the people they tried - and failed - to protect.

programme.title: The Royal Scandal
programme.desc: Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's Sherlock Holmes - the world's greatest detective - faces a most alluring adversary... Legendary opera star Irene Adler is threatening to destroy the King of Bohemia's reputation with proof of their illicit affair. The evidence? A photograph. Her ransom? The king's hand in marriage. But not only does investigating detective Sherlock Holmes already know Irene from the past, he also knows that the queen of manipulation would never resort to such a common crime. After uncovering her true ambitions, Holmes draws the cunning songstress into a well-matched game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: XIII: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: Female US president Sheridan is killed from a mile by a masterly sniper who leaves no trace. The vice-president, now having succeeded for a short end of term, is contested by her brother, governor Wally Sheridan, who plays the national insecurity card, as the murder is only the first of series of terrorist strikes. Colonel Amos and his team are given a free hand to track down and catch the killer at all cost. Ross Tanner, who is found by a retired couple and lovingly nursed after a bad fall from a helicopter, comes to realize trough serious amnesia he's probably the sniper. Two teams track him down. La Mangouste's commando team kills the couple, tortures him and anyone known to have crossed his path but looses him again. General Carrington tells him his identity is an elaborate fake to intrude the conspiracy which uses the collateral victims at every terrorist strike, all tattooed with Roman numerals, like his XIII.

programme.title: XIII: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: Ross Tanner successfully deals with his multiple identity mystery and the terrorist threats as well as a top-level conspiracy including the White House chief of staff, which La Mangouste fails to protect against him. Wally Sheridan is elected instead of president Galbraith, who thanks him and general Carrington. Yet 'XIII' senses something isn't right.

His fiancéeʼs prim-and-proper society mother disapproves of her choice of husband and insists on controlling every aspect of the wedding. Can Nick Claus win over his in-laws and ensure that the ceremony goes smoothly?

programme.title: Jane Doe: The Wrong Face
programme.desc: Mystery thriller about Cathy Davis (Lea Thompson, 'Back to the Future'), a housewife and mother who leads a double life as a government agent. Despite having retired from undercover work, Cathy is called back into service when the wife of a prominent lawyer is kidnapped. She soon finds herself facing one of the most baffling puzzles of her career.

programme.desc: When Mark goes for a visit with his uncle he's thrown into a world he knows not much about. Little does he know it'll be a world he's going to have to become very familiar with. One character Mark becomes very familiar and friendly with is a very tame black bear who he later names Ben.

programme.desc: Homeless woman Yvonne Caldwell (Chandra Wilson) is a woman with good reason to be bitter: she has lost everything except her two beloved dogs, Bebe and Man-Man. With her one friend, Wes (Ben Vereen), Caldwell lives the daily struggle of being homeless in Los Angeles until a chance encounter caused by her dogs leads to a friendship with Los Angeles Police Department officer Tami Baumann (Kathleen Munroe), and hope for a better life begins in earnest for Yvonne. Friendship between the two women seemed improbable, but their friendship provided a base of support and respect for Yvonne and Tami for more than five years.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: This episode starts 12 years after the first Dune miniseries. Duke Paul Atreides has become emperor. During an attack he is blinded but utilizes his "visions of the future" to see. Chani his concubine has given him twins - Leto II and Ghanima. When his children are attacked, Paul uses Leto's eyes to see and avert the danger, but in the process loses his psychic vision and becomes completely blind. In accordance with Fremen custom, he walks into the desert and leaves his children in the care of his sister, Alia.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As conspiracies to gain political power abound, Paul's power base is eroded from within and his highly ambitious sister, Alia is gaining a political foothold. Born aware of her ancestral memories, Alia is considered an abomination by the Bene Gesserit. The Lady Jessica, her mother returns to Dune (Arrakis) to visit her grandchildren Leto II and Ghanima. When one particular ancestor begins to possess Alia, Lady Jessica has to take refuge. Leto II and Ghanima devise a plan toward salvation.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As Alia becomes totally possessed she also has to deal with rebel Fremen. Ghanima, who survived an attack on her by House Corrino, is now engaged to Farad'n Corrino. Unexpectedly, Leto II returns from the desert being believed dead. While in the desert his body has absorbed some sand-trout, slowly mutating him into a sand-worm. Alia resists possession by the baron while Irulan declines Jessica's offer to return with her to Caladan.

programme.title: Blackout
programme.desc: Blackout is a drama series starring Christopher Eccleston as Daniel Demoys a man who feels a stranger in his own life. Over the years he has gone from being an idealistic young man with desire to a disillusioned and corrupt council official. His life is now a complete mess and he is drinking heavily and suffering with blackouts. He has also been passing council contract details to local businessman Henry Pulis.

programme.desc: Part 1 of 2. The year is 1891 and Wyoming is in its first year of statehood. The three Hammett brothers, Cain, Harry and Dale, find themselves in the middle of a rapidly escalating range war that pits cattle barons against homesteaders.

programme.title: Johnson County War
programme.desc: Western with Burt Reynolds. Three brothers become embroiled in a rapidly escalating range war that pits old time cattle barons against homesteaders.

programme.title: The Secrets in the Walls
programme.desc: Molly, Lizzie (two sisters), and their mom, Rachel, move from downtown Detroit to Ferndale, Michigan, into a very old house. After many strange things begin to happen, Rachel does some research on the house's history and finds out that the house was owned in the 1950s by a 17-year-old Germans girl, Greta, and her abusive husband, and that while she lived there, she went missing and was never seen again. Upon searching the house, Rachel and her brother discover the girl's skeleton boarded up inside the wall of Lizzie's bedroom with scratch marks on the wood inside, suggesting she was locked in there while still alive. They assume that by releasing her remains, she can move on in peace to the spirit realm. However, after being locked up for so long and deprived of her life, Greta isn't so compliant.

programme.title: Family Plan
programme.desc: Charlie works for a company that is taken over by Walcott who believes family values are a priority. Career-driven Charlie does a little fibbing when under the pressure of Walcott's standards, and believes she's in the clear. But when Walcott invites himself over for dinner, she borrows her friend's house and daughter and hires actor Buck to play her husband for the evening. The one-night "act" turns into a full-time gig when her boss decides to rent the house next door for the summer, forcing Charlie and Buck to stay together in the fake lifestyle she created.

programme.title: Merlin's Apprentice
programme.desc: Awakened after a fifty year rest, the supreme sorcerer Merlin returns to Camelot to find the kingdom in ruins, depleted after the theft of the Holy Grail, its greatest form of protection. Seeking help, he employs the services of a young thief and beggar by the name of Jack, himself a man of magical talent. Merlin and Jack set out to discover the whereabouts of the Holy Grail, with Jack now his apprentice, but they find the kingdom on the brink of attack and doom. The 2006 two-part series is a sequel to the original 1998 series, with Sam Neill and Miranda Richardson reprising their roles as Merlin and the Lady of the Lake.

programme.title: A Sudden Fury
programme.desc: The film begins with an unknown person hiding an axe covered with blood in the woods. It then focuses on Brian Hannigan, a teenager who contacts the police after the death of his adoptive parents, a double homicide. The investigators immediately see Brian as a suspect, because he was in the house when the murders occurred, is thought to have been too calm considering the circumstances, while also claiming to have heard nothing during the night his parents were murdered. Chris Hannigan, Brian's 7-year-old adoptive brother, tells the police that he saw his other adoptive brother, 17-year-old Daniel, an aggressive patient at a mental hospital, walking away from the house only seconds after the tragedy. Although Daniel denies having been at the house around the time of the murder, he becomes the prime suspect.

programme.title: The Society Murders
programme.desc: A building inspector arrives at Wentworth to inspect the rebuilding, but he's a fake. Once inside the jail, he knocks Colleen out, ties her up, and plants bombs around the prison. Meg rescues Colleen, but the women have been locked in the laundry with a bomb inside ticking away... Sharon is charged with murder as Alpha Centauri's true nature is exposed in the press, shattering her illusions. Helen decides to implicate herself to help her sister. Lizzie gets wind of Petra and Scott's relationship but vows to keep quiet. Petra tells Lizzie her father abused her, and was going to do the same to her sister, Emma, which is why she killed him. Later, when Emma visits Petra, we learn it was actually Emma who killed him. Lucy attacks Major the dog to stop him finding her drugs, and a furious Joan turfs her out. Ann forgives Wally. Lizzie gets a telegram from Foxy.

The woman is forced to question her faith and reassess her views.

programme.desc: Canadian RCMP officer Zoe Brennan, Australian Federal Policeman Mark Waldman and a young East Timorese translator named Ismenio Soares are brought together by the UN's fateful effort to give the Timorese a voice in their own future. In the chaotic run-up to the vote, these initially reluctant partners become real friends. But when the UN evacuates in the post-ballot rampage, Mark and Zoe are forced to abandon Ismenio and his family to a nightmarish fate. Haunted by guilt, the two westerners each find their way back to Timor, driven to make amends to the people they tried - and failed - to protect.

programme.title: Replacing Dad
programme.desc: Linda and George live in a small town. He is the school principal. They are about to celebrate their 16th anniversary. She catches him with her daughter's young teacher, and has to deal with the kids, the town and her love to him.

programme.title: Family Plan
programme.desc: Charlie works for a company that is taken over by Walcott who believes family values are a priority. Career-driven Charlie does a little fibbing when under the pressure of Walcott's standards, and believes she's in the clear. But when Walcott invites himself over for dinner, she borrows her friend's house and daughter and hires actor Buck to play her husband for the evening. The one-night "act" turns into a full-time gig when her boss decides to rent the house next door for the summer, forcing Charlie and Buck to stay together in the fake lifestyle she created.

programme.title: The Last Cowboy
programme.desc: John William "Will" Cooper is a modern-day rancher, maintaining his ranch in hard times along with his friend and foreman Amos Russell. When Will's estranged daughter Jake returns to the ranch for her grandfather's funeral, father and daughter clash over how to run the ranch and over the death years before of Jake's mother, which she blames on Will. Crisis comes in the form of insurmountable debt, and it is only by working together that Will and Jake have any chance of saving their home and their family.

programme.title: King Solomon's Mines
programme.desc: This re-telling of the eighteen century novel of the same name, by H. Rider Haggard, features Patrick Swayze. The main character (Swayze), is called Allan Quatermain and is a treasure hunter in search this time, of King Solomon's hidden treasure. With the help of a group of people, one of which is a woman trying to locate her father, Sir Henry, who went missing years ago, they embark on the dangerous journey. On their coat tails is a group of hostile and violent African tribesmen and a fellow explorer.

programme.title: Icon
programme.desc: A former US Operative, who lived in Russia in his earlier years and had been married there with a child, comes out of retirement to face down a former enemy, now running as a candidate for President in modern Russia. Working with a Russian policewoman, they work to uncover a plot to use biological weapons against certain factions of the Russian people to commit genocide. The virus would also be released in other populations, but would be treated making the candidate a hero. A side plot has the agent being reunited with his long lost daughter.

programme.title: XIII: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: Female US president Sheridan is killed from a mile by a masterly sniper who leaves no trace. The vice-president, now having succeeded for a short end of term, is contested by her brother, governor Wally Sheridan, who plays the national insecurity card, as the murder is only the first of series of terrorist strikes. Colonel Amos and his team are given a free hand to track down and catch the killer at all cost. Ross Tanner, who is found by a retired couple and lovingly nursed after a bad fall from a helicopter, comes to realize trough serious amnesia he's probably the sniper. Two teams track him down. La Mangouste's commando team kills the couple, tortures him and anyone known to have crossed his path but looses him again. General Carrington tells him his identity is an elaborate fake to intrude the conspiracy which uses the collateral victims at every terrorist strike, all tattooed with Roman numerals, like his XIII.

programme.title: EuroLeague. Real Madrid - Panathinaikos
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Summer grants abundance, but in the race to make the most of a brief window of warmth, it also brings competition, aggression and danger. High up on the mountain meadows, Alpine marmots fight for the best hideouts in which to raise young, but can they escape hungry bears? The Carpathian bear cubs are growing fast but are at risk of being attacked by competitive adult males. Can their mothers' clever strategies protect them? Herds of bison thunder through the ancient woodlands in search of food and water. They're a triumph of rewilding because their trampling boosts life throughout the forest, like the insects that multiply in the billions. These bugs must then find food and turn to herds of red deer. Plagued by biting insects, the deer run up the mountains to escape, only to risk falling prey to rare wild cats.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Autumn transforms the mountainsides of the Carpathians into sweeping carpets of bronze, amber and gold. The forests echo with the powerful roars of red deer stags, signaling the fight for the right to herd females. The battle is gladiatorial, and the weakened losers are picked off by wolf packs prowling for an easy meal across the forests. For bears, it's time to gorge themselves on berries and nuts to put on weight before hibernation. Despite their immense size, they climb beech and pine trunks to reach the juiciest nuts at the very top. They even stray into human terrain to raid cornfields, willing to do anything to satisfy their hunger. The survival of all these magnificent creatures depends on the old-growth trees, which absorb harmful carbon from the atmosphere and regulate the Earth's temperature for all to live.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Winter favors animals with clever adaptations to survive. Even though the Carpathian Mountains are in the grip of snow and ice, they are still teeming with life. Chamois, a creature descended from the Ice Age, have special hooves to run across steep slopes without slipping, which are perfect for chasing females vertically downhill at the insanely high speeds of 50 kilometers per hour. Crossbills have hooked beaks to pluck seeds from spruce cones. As for the rare capercaillie, they digest pine needles by eating stones that grind the needles up in their digestive system. Despite the challenging but seasonal weather conditions, winter is mating season for the Carpathian's most elusive inhabitant and rarest animal: the lynx. Almost extinct in the rest of Europe, the vast wilderness of the Carpathians helps the species survive and thrive.

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Through the cycle of the seasons, Spain's Sierra de Gredos National Park, one of Europe's most remarkable natural landscapes, is revealed. From ancient glacial cirques and deep mountain ravines to the summit of Almanzor, the highest peak in central Spain, discover a unique and fragile ecosystem. Here, the Spanish ibex, an iconic species that defines the spirit of these mountains, reigns. Alongside it, golden eagles, alpine birds and otters inhabit a territory shaped by isolation and resilience. This is a portrait of wilderness and balance, a window into one of Europe's last great wild spaces.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bullshark
programme.desc: We know Bull Sharks swim upriver and we know they hunt in the sea. But we've never been able to see it all like this. We see them attack and consume other sharks. We watch their shady hunts in the deep. We follow them up freshwater rivers to pupping grounds. We see them hunt shoals of fish from drones above and we watch as they clash with hippos and crocs.

programme.title: Big Little Giants
programme.desc: Set in Botswana's vast and untamed wilderness, "Big Little Giants" follows Africa's youngest animals as they take their first steps into a challenging world shaped by drought, predators and ancient migration routes. From a newborn elephant learning to keep pace with its herd to jackal pups testing their instincts and cheetah cubs preparing for life at astonishing speed, each story unfolds through intimate moments of learning and loss. Guided by parents, siblings and instinct, these young animals must quickly adapt or fall behind. Through stunning landscapes and close-up encounters, discover how courage, family bonds and resilience shape survival during the most fragile stage of life in the wild.

programme.title: Secrets of the Octopus
programme.desc: Octopus are like aliens on earth but they have one superpower that we are only now beginning to fully appreciate. By changing their color hundreds of times an hour, or transforming the shape of their bodies to mimic their deadliest enemies, octopus are the most extraordinary shapeshifters on the planet.

programme.title: Amur Tiger: Secret Kingdom

programme.title: Killer Shark vs. Killer Whale
programme.desc: Killer Shark vs. Killer Whale examined an extraordinary incident that occurred at the Farallon Islands, 27 miles off San Francisco, in October 1997. Two killer whales attacked and drowned a great white shark and ripped out its liver. The incident left biologists mystified. Since then there have been more attacks internationally. What is happening between the two apex predators of the oceans? There are still so many questions left to answer.

programme.title: Song of the Rainforest
programme.desc: China's Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park is a breathtaking biodiversity hotspot where flora and fauna compete and coexist in a delicate dance of survival. This unique location — an island with soaring 1800-meter peaks — has created an environment where plants and animals have evolved in relative isolation from the mainland to live together. The rare Hainan black-crested gibbon, one of the rarest mammals on Earth, sustains the forest by dispersing seeds far and wide in its poop. Weaver ants wage war in the canopy, building homes and finding scorpions to snack on. Pointed-scale pit vipers lurk in the underbrush while shrews and other rodents scramble to find fruit and other morsels that have dropped from the canopy.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to Vietnam's mountainous forests to discover endangered pangolins, Asian palm civets, and the golden-headed langurs of Cat Ba Island. The recently discovered Vietnamese crocodile lizard is already vulnerable to smuggling, while the critically endangered Delacour's langurs take refuge in a nature reserve. In springtime, an astonishing diversity of butterfly species congregates in the forest.

programme.title: Something Bit Me!
programme.desc: An expert river guide in Zimbabwe meets more than his match in treacherous waters. Despite repeated maulings that leave him with 38 major bite wounds, he survives to tell his tale. programme.title: Secrets of the Zoo: Tampa the Wild Side Updates

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: Whether right whales, penguins or sea lions - for the birth of their young, many marine creatures are drawn to Argentina's nearly 5,000 kilometer coastline. From their very first breath, it's all about one thing for the little ones: survival. Orcas hunt for young sea lions with a special technique and seagulls fly merciless aerial attacks on baby whales. Extraordinary underwater images and impressive animal behavior make the film by Christian Baumeister a visual experience.

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: In Argentina's breathtaking, yet imposing wilderness, every day is a fight for survival. The terrain is rugged and parched. The air is thin. The weather can change in an instant. And then there are the predators. A female puma stalks a valley in search of guanaco, while a tarantula defends itself against a hungry armadillo. Foxes will scavenge what they can…until one of the world's largest vultures shows up. All the while, in the background, glaciers greedily hold on to the freshwater these animals so desperately need.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Meet Dr. Pol, an expert in large farm animals and pets. This senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, no-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Nat Geo WILD follows The Incredible Dr. Pol as he travels across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness. Treating numerous patients, including horses, pigs, cows, sheep, alpacas, goats, cats, dogs and even an occasional reindeer, Dr. Pol is not your average vet.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: At the western end of the Mediterranean lies Portugal, full of diverse ecosystems that showcase a stunning array of species both big and small, many of which are endemic to the region. Its interconnected web allows each creature a way to survive the rugged landscape. A fire salamander that can live up to 50 years enjoys its first meal after spending a dormant summer underground. One of the rarest wild cats on the planet, the Iberian lynx hunts for its favorite prey: rabbit. Golden eagles and foxes, known to be enemies, tolerate each other for long enough to share their kill. And young Iberian ibex practice for adulthood by knocking their antlers together in an impressive display of strength.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Life on the coast of Portugal is full of beauty and brutality for the unique animals that live there, from the smallest phytoplankton to the giant sperm whales. Fiddler crabs fight for breeding rights in the coastal lagoons. Cuttlefish, the ultimate masters of disguise, creep in on unsuspecting prey. Storks perch precariously on the Atlantic cliffs, protecting their chicks from predators. And sparrowhawks, a top predator endemic to the region, face an uncertain future with human activities and wildfires threatening the youngest generation.

programme.title: Supersized Sharks
programme.desc: Has a small island in the middle of the South Pacific become a drive-thru burger joint for the world's largest Tiger Sharks? Luring the giants to their boat, shark biologists Lauren Meyers, Charlie Huveneers and Adam Barnette investigate and are surprised to discover that beef is not the only unusual item on the menu.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The quiet charm of Germany's Central Uplands lies in ancient forests and wild beauty. Through the autumn forest, the booming call of a stag echoes through the mist. It's rutting season! In Saxon Switzerland, peregrine falcons and black storks inhabit picturesque cliffs. The elusive lynx roams the forests, while in the Harz, a new, wilder forest is growing in the shifting climate.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Journey into Australia's forests to meet an unforgettable cast of baby animals. Follow koala joeys as they go from tiny pouch-bound newborns to adventurous climbers. Watch flying fox pups grow into skilled young fliers, while kookaburra chicks discover their voices and begin exploring the world beyond the nest. In the rainforests of Queensland, rare tree kangaroo joeys peek out from their mothers' pouches, and striped cassowary chicks learn essential survival skills from one of nature's most dedicated dads. Along the way, discover how possums — and even tiny caterpillars — grow, play and prepare for life on their own. Filled with fascinating wildlife facts, remarkable family stories and stunning natural behavior, this episode reveals the challenges, surprises and milestones that shape the lives of Australia's youngest forest residents.

programme.title: Most Wanted Sharks
programme.desc: There are millions of sharks in our oceans, but a select few are so fascinating, they've become worldwide celebrities. Whether it's the biggest great white, the most photographed tiger shark, or the shark known for jumping 100 feet up out of the water, we're diving into the stories of the greatest shark stars of all time, each with their own legion of social media followers.

programme.title: Return of the White Shark
programme.desc: Cape Cod — America's Playground — is a newly emerging hotspot for a top predator. Great Whites are appearing in increasing numbers, when for centuries there were none. Through spectacular imagery, we'll see how the landscape of Cape Cod has changed over time, and what is luring Great Whites in record numbers.

programme.title: Sharks of the North
programme.desc: Sightings of great white sharks have been on the rise in Atlantic Canada. Alanna Canaran, a passionate science educator and dive instructor, embarks on a mission to unravel the enigmas surrounding these magnificent creatures and is determined to dispel fear of sharks in Nova Scotians. As the journey unfolds, Canaran and her team dive into the history of human-shark relationships along the coast. Facing numerous challenges, including elusive sharks and treacherous weather conditions, the team perseveres. With sheer determination and a stroke of luck, they gather invaluable knowledge of these magnificent creatures, contributing to a better understanding of white sharks in Canada.

programme.title: Cannibal Sharks
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. Cannibal Sharks pulls in two of the world's leading shark experts to unpack and analyze the mounting evidence that shark-on-shark attacks happen a lot more than we ever realized.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Set sail for Australia's extraordinary islands and meet a fascinating cast of baby animals. Follow green sea turtle hatchlings as they race from sandy nests to the ocean, fur seal pups learning to swim along rugged coastlines, and quokka joeys taking their first hops beside their mothers. In Tasmania, feisty Tasmanian devil joeys emerge from the pouch ready to explore. Far to the south on subantarctic Macquarie Island, fluffy king penguin chicks, elephant seal pups and young albatrosses face the challenges of life in a harsh and windswept world. Packed with amazing animal behaviors, surprising wildlife facts and unforgettable family moments, this episode reveals the remarkable journeys that transform Australia's island babies from vulnerable newborns into confident young adventurers.

programme.title: Baby Animals Down Under
programme.desc: Journey deep into the Australian bush and discover a remarkable world of baby animals growing up beyond the cities and coastline. Meet wombat youngsters learning to explore their underground world and tiny echidna puggles developing the protective spines that will help them survive. Watch wild brumby foals find their footing in rugged bushland, while peewee chicks, bush stone-curlew chicks and monarch butterfly caterpillars face their own unique challenges on the path to adulthood. From learning what to eat and how to avoid danger to mastering essential skills through play, exploration and family guidance, every youngster must prepare for life on its own. Along the way, witness extraordinary transformations, incredible parenting strategies and surprising survival adaptations found nowhere else in the world.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Wallykazam!
programme.desc: Wally's grumpy neighbor, Stan of the Swamp, won't give back his new glider unless Wally can make him laugh! Can Wally use his magic stick to make M words that'll get a chuckle out of the swamp monster?

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Best friends and cadets-in-training Swift, Penny, Rod, and Brody congregate at Top Wing Academy, where they learn what it takes to gain their wings and become rescue birds on Big Swirl Island. Swift is a blue jay and the fastest pilot at the academy; Penny, the only female in the group, is a penguin, and she is an expert at undersea life; Brody is a puffin who takes a more land approach, and Rod is a rooster who is ready to fly around Big Swirl Island in his all-terrain vehicle. The four friends are joined by their mentor Speedy, who helps the cadets on their different missions. "Top Wing" focuses on the importance of teamwork and the ability to successfully solve problems.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When Aang is assigned to help defend a town from a monster that has been plaguing the town, his lack of ability and knowledge becomes obvious, as he doesn't know what to do. However, when Sokka tries to rush to Aang's rescue during the fight, he himself becomes captured and is taken away by the monster, which turns out to be from the spirit world. Aang promises Katara that he'll find Sokka and bring him back, but with Aang even doubting himself, will he be capable of finding where the monster went?

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

This makes Donnie, Leo, and Mikey very suspicious, since Raph has kept everything a secret from them. But audiences love Raph, which pleases the crime boss Kitsune and her street gang, the Purple Dragons. They run the arena with the help of an obnoxious investor named Knox. Carroll Shelby ha vinto la prestigiosa 24 Ore di Le Mans nel 1959 ma una patologia cardiaca gli proibisce di continuare a gareggiare. Si reinventa allora designer di automobili e accetta la proposta della Ford: progettare una macchina in grado di battere il bolide della Ferrari. Ma oltre al motore, per vincere serve anche un pilota super. E la scelta di Shelby ricade su Ken Miles, un intrepido e irascibile pilota britannico. Nel cast Remo Girone interpreta Enzo Ferrari.

programme.desc: Gerard Butler, Aaron Eckhart e il premio Oscar Morgan Freeman in un action fra le vie di Londra. La misteriosa morte del premier britannico raduna a Londra tutti i capi di stato occidentali per i funerali di stato. I Servizi Segreti sono in stato di allerta, il pericolo di un attacco terroristico e' molto elevato. Ma nessuno puo' soltanto minimamente ipotizzare quello che sta per accadere. Nemmeno Mike Banning, capo dei servizi segreti del Presidente degli Stati Uniti, ancora una volta in prima linea per sventare la strage. Sequel di "Attacco al potere - Olympus Has Fallen".

Le cose sono cambiate ma a loro conviene fingere di essere una coppia per placare un ex asfissiante e per ingelosire una nuova fiamma.

programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Lillo & Greg, star di una commedia degli equivoci con Anna Foglietta e Francesco Mura. Due ex compagni di scuola decidono di scambiarsi i rispettivi codici genetici.

programme.desc: Michael Bay dirige Sean Connery e Nicolas Cage nel celebre action. Un generale prende in ostaggio un gruppo di turisti nella prigione di Alcatraz e minaccia di far esplodere San Francisco. Un agente dell'FBI esperto di armi chimiche e un ex agente dei servizi segreti inglesi, l'unico ad esser mai fuggito da Alcatraz, vengono ingaggiati dal governo per sventare il folle piano del militare che tiene la citta' sotto la minaccia di missili al gas nervino. Dovranno introdursi dentro 'The Rock' l'inespugnabile fortezza chiusa nel 1963.

programme.desc: Ángela, una donna sorda, aspetta un figlio dal suo compagno Héctor che è udente. Con la nascita della bambina, Ona, iniziano a emergere paure e dubbi.

programme.title: Diana - La storia segreta di Lady D
programme.desc: Naomi Watts interpreta la principessa piu' amata di sempre nel film che ne ricostruisce la favola tragica, fra cronaca e retroscena. Dalla separazione dal Principe Carlo all'amore spezzato per Hasnat Khan, fino alla notte di Parigi in cui Diana perse la vita in un incidente.

programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige Morgan Freeman e Matt Damon in un biopic sportivo. Sudafrica, 1995. Per il presidente Mandela, la coppa del mondo di rugby è l'occasione per unire bianchi e neri.

programme.desc: Johnny Depp nel film ispirato alla vita dell'ultima amante di Luigi XV. Una ragazza di umili origini usa la sua bellezza per introdursi nei salotti mondani fino alla corte di Versailles.

programme.title: C'era una volta a New York
programme.desc: Nella New York degli anni Venti, le sorelle polacche Ewa e Magda emigrano dalla Polonia a New York. Giunte a Ellis Island, scoprono che Magda è malata di tubercolosi e viene messa in quarantena. Ewa si ritrova sola e indifesa.

programme.title: Alexander
programme.desc: Oliver Stone dirige Colin Farrell nel kolossal che racconta l'ascesa e il tragico destino di Alessandro Magno, il glorioso condottiero che conquisto' tutto il mondo conosciuto.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: Il silenzio degli altri
programme.desc: Ángela, una donna sorda, aspetta un figlio dal suo compagno Héctor che è udente. Con la nascita della bambina, Ona, iniziano a emergere paure e dubbi.

programme.title: Francesca e Giovanni: Una storia d'amore e di mafia
programme.desc: Simona Izzo e Ricky Tognazzi raccontano la storia d'amore tra Francesca Morvillo e Giovanni Falcone: un rapporto intenso che li vedrà uniti fino agli ultimi istanti delle loro vite.

programme.desc: Sci-Fi distopico di Alfonso Cuaron, con Clive Owen, Julianne Moore e Michael Caine. 2027: un ex attivista protegge l'unica donna rimasta incinta in un'umanita' colpita dall'infertilita'.

programme.title: Il colosso di Rodi
programme.desc: Lo spettacolare esordio alla regia di Sergio Leone. Sull'isola greca un gruppo di congiurati si ribella contro il Re Serse, mentre i Fenici stanno per attaccare la citta'.

programme.desc: Esordio hollywoodiano per Gabriele Muccino che dirige Will Smith in un film emozionante. San Francisco, anni 80: un uomo disperato trova la forza di ricominciare grazie a suo figlio.

programme.title: Hurricane - Il grido dell'innocenza
programme.desc: Un magnifico Denzel Washington nella travolgente biografia di Rubin "Hurricane" Carter. All'apice della carriera, il celebre pugile viene accusato ingiustamente di omicidio.

programme.title: Snowden
programme.desc: Joseph Gordon-Levitt interpreta Edward Snowden in un biografia che Oliver Stone gira con la potenza di un incalzante thriller politico. Nel 2013, il giovane informatico si licenzia dalla National Security Agency, abbandona i suoi rigidi ideali patriottici e convoca due giornalisti in un albergo di Hong Kong, ai quali rivelera' la subdola e diffusa violazione della privacy elaborata dal governo americano. Un metodo illegale di cui sono vittime anche privati cittadini. Sulla vicenda di Edward Snowden e' stato girato anche il documentario "Citizenfour", premiato con l'Oscar.

programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: La Befana vien di notte II - Le origini

programme.title: E.T. L'extra-terrestre
programme.desc: 4 Oscar all'emozionante capolavoro di fantascienza di Steven Spielberg. Un bambino protegge dagli scienziati un alieno rimasto sulla Terra e lo aiuta a tornare sul suo pianeta.

programme.desc: Moderna favola natalizia tratta dai libri di Michael Bond. Un orso peruviano vola a Londra alla ricerca di una vita migliore. L'amorevole famiglia Brown fara' avverare il suo sogno.

programme.desc: Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman e Julia Roberts in un film di Steven Spielberg. Peter, ormai adulto, deve tornare sull’Isola che non c'e' per ritrovare i suoi figli, rapiti da Capitan Uncino.

Scaraventati attraverso un portale in un bizzarro paese delle meraviglie chiamato Overworld, quattro improvvisati avventurieri devono portare a termine una magica missione per tornare a casa.

programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Shrek", un film d'animazione con le allegre creature dal ciuffo ribelle. La principessa Poppy e il malinconico Branch devono salvare i Trolls dai loro mortali nemici.

programme.desc: Caccia all'assassino in un thriller con Martin Lawrence e John Malkovich. Per trovare un killer imitatore, due detective chiedono aiuto all'omicida seriale a cui si ispira.

In questo scenario da incubo, Nico, immune al virus, è pronto a infrangere la legge per liberare la sua fidanzata dall'isolamento.

programme.title: Il potere dei soldi
programme.desc: Robert Luketic dirige con maestria Gary Oldman e Harrison Ford in uno spy-thriller sullo spietato mondo dell'alta finanza a Wall Street. Dopo aver commesso un imperdonabile errore, un giovane e ambizioso impiegato di una multinazionale ha la possibilita' di riabilitarsi agli occhi del suo capo e salvare il posto. Ma il boss in realta' lo ricatta, costringendolo a farsi assumere dalla societa' concorrente per rubare il prototipo di un nuovo prodotto. Dalla padella nella brace, si accorgera' di essere la semplice pedina di uno sporco gioco.

programme.title: Dead Of Winter - Sfida Nel Gelo
programme.desc: Una vedova affranta dal dolore si ferma in una baita isolata dopo essersi persa sulle strade del Minnesota in pieno inverno. Ben presto si ritrova coinvolta in una lotta disperata per la sopravvivenza quando incontra una coppia di assassini.

programme.title: Io sono leggenda

programme.title: Gli uccelli

programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original al cardiopalma con Mel Gibson. Un conduttore radiofonico riceve in diretta la chiamata di un ascoltatore anonimo che minaccia di uccidere lui e la sua famiglia.

programme.title: Un giorno di ordinaria follia
programme.desc: Viaggio allucinato nella follia omicida di un uomo qualunque con Michael Douglas. Il quarantenne William Foster non sta passando un momento facile: lasciato dalla moglie e allontanato dalla figlia in seguito a un'ordinanza del giudice, viene preso da un raptus. Intrappolato in un ingorgo stradale, perde completamente la testa e comincia a uccidere chiunque gli capiti a tiro. Le sue gesta violente fanno il giro della città e del caso viene incaricato un detective (Robert Duvall) al suo ultimo giorno di servizio. Dal regista di "Linea mortale", Joel Schumacher.

programme.desc: Jack Nicholson nel capolavoro horror di Stanley Kubrick. Dopo averne accettato l'impiego di custode invernale, uno scrittore si trasferisce insieme alla famiglia in un remoto hotel di montagna.

programme.desc: Thriller voyeuristico con Carolina Sala, opera prima di Domenico Croce. Una ragazza che vive isolata nella sua stanza si convince che nel palazzo di fronte si sia consumato un crimine.

programme.desc: Thriller di Alberto Rodríguez nel mondo del lavoro portuale. Due fratelli sommozzatori in difficoltà economiche entrano in un pericoloso gioco che mette a rischio le loro vite.

programme.desc: Guy Pearce e Stephen Lang in un horror satanico. Un esperto esorcista conduce un giovane sacerdote nel mondo delle possessioni demoniache in un terrificante percorso di iniziazione.

programme.desc: François Ozon dirige una commedia a tinte gialle nella Parigi degli anni 30. Una giovane aspirante attrice viene accusata dell'omicidio di un famoso produttore. Nel cast Isabelle Huppert.

programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original - di Peter Chelsom e con Marco D'Amore - sui torbidi segreti di una nota località turistica versiliese.

programme.title: Diabolik - Ginko all'attacco!
programme.desc: I Manetti Bros. dirigono Giacomo Gianniotti, Miriam Leone, Valerio Mastandrea e Monica Bellucci nel secondo film sul fumetto cult. Diabolik ed Eva Kant cadono nel piano di Ginko.

programme.desc: Ben Affleck contro Samuel L. Jackson in un thriller senza esclusione di colpi. Un banale tamponamento tra un avvocato e un padre di famiglia ex alcolista scatena la rabbia di entrambi.

programme.title: Fall
programme.desc: Le migliori amiche, Becky e Hunter, rischiano tutto quando salgono in cima a una torre radio di 2.000 piedi.

programme.desc: Intenso thriller con Shailene Woodley. Un'agente di polizia dal passato problematico viene reclutata dall'FBI per rintracciare un assassino che terrorizza la città.

programme.title: Out of Sight
programme.desc: George Clooney e Jennifer Lopez in un thriller di Steven Soderbergh, tratto da un romanzo di Elmore Leonard. Un rapinatore gentiluomo evade dal carcere e prende in ostaggio una poliziotta.

programme.desc: Gran Premio della Giuria a Cannes per il film pulp di Park Chan-Wook. Un uomo, segregato in una stanza per quindici anni, cerca vendetta nei confronti del suo sconosciuto aguzzino.

programme.title: The Outfit
programme.desc: Thriller che segna l'esordio alla regia per Graham Moore, con Mark Rylance e Zoey Deutch. Chicago, anni 50: la bottega di un sarto inglese diventa l'epicentro di una faida tra gangster.

programme.title: Downton Abbey - Il gran finale
programme.desc: Nel terzo capitolo della saga tratta dall'omonimo period drama televisivo, gli aristocratici Crawley affrontano lo scandalo pubblico scoppiato per il divorzio di Lady Mary, candidata a prendere in mano le redini della famiglia.

programme.title: Beata te
programme.desc: Serena Rossi e Fabio Balsamo nella commedia Sky Original di Paola Randi. Marta riceve la visita dell'Arcangelo che le annuncia l'arrivo di un figlio. Basteranno 14 giorni per decidere?

programme.title: Sai che c'è di nuovo?
programme.desc: Madonna e Rupert Everett in una commedia di John Schlesinger. Una maestra di yoga e un giardiniere gay, amici per la pelle, fanno sesso dopo una notte di euforia e lei rimane incinta...

programme.title: Speciale: Nord Sud Ovest Est
programme.desc: Un racconto corale dietro le quinte della serie. Attori, registi e capi reparto svelano il set, le scelte creative e il successo del progetto.

programme.title: Rifkin's Festival
programme.desc: Woody Allen dirige Gina Gershon e Louis Garrel in una commedia che racconta le vicissitudini di un ex insegnante di cinema, al seguito della moglie al Festival di San Sebastian.

programme.title: Book Club - Tutto puo' succedere
programme.desc: Diane Keaton e Jane Fonda in una commedia sulla riscoperta del desiderio. La lettura del romanzo "Cinquanta sfumature di grigio" risveglia le piccanti curiosita' di quattro signore.

programme.title: Lei
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe 2014 alla sceneggiatura per lo struggente racconto di una love story incredibile. Il solitario Theodore (Joaquin Phoenix) si innamora della voce di un sofisticato computer (Scarlett Johansson nella versione originale e Micaela Ramazzotti in quella italiana).

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Oscar alla migliore canzone per l'opera prima di Bradley Cooper, anche protagonista insieme a Lady Gaga. Un esperto musicista aiuta una cantante a farsi strada nel mondo dello spettacolo.

programme.title: Cafe' Society
programme.desc: Commedia di Woody Allen con Jesse Eisenberg, Kristen Stewart e Steve Carell. Anni '30: il giovane Bobby parte per Los Angeles in cerca di fortuna nel cinema e si innamora di Vonnie.

programme.title: Innamorarsi
programme.desc: Un'intensa storia romantica con la straordinaria coppia da Oscar, Robert De Niro-Meryl Streep. Lui ingegnere, lei disegnatrice pubblicitaria, si incontrano casualmente in una libreria di New York, alla vigilia di Natale. Si rivedono poi ogni giorno, sul treno per andare a lavoro. Entrambi sposati, si innamorano sia pure tra mille riserve che alla fine prendono il sopravvento. Tra loro cala il silenzio, ma il destino li fara' incontrare ancora un anno piu' tardi... David di Donatello alla Streep come miglior attrice straniera.

programme.title: Sposa in rosso
programme.desc: Sarah Felberbaum ed Eduardo Noriega in una commedia di Gianni Costantino, tra Malta e la Puglia. Due sconosciuti organizzano un finto matrimonio per intascare i soldi dei regali di nozze.

programme.title: Rifkin's Festival
programme.desc: Woody Allen dirige Gina Gershon e Louis Garrel in una commedia che racconta le vicissitudini di un ex insegnante di cinema, al seguito della moglie al Festival di San Sebastian.

programme.title: Love Again
programme.desc: Commedia romantica con la partecipazione di Celine Dion. Per lenire il dolore, Mira continua a inviare messaggi al fidanzato defunto, ignara che il numero è stato riassegnato.

programme.title: C'eravamo tanto amati
programme.desc: Nino Manfredi, Vittorio Gassman e Stefania Sandrelli nel capolavoro di Ettore Scola. La storia di tre amici, ex partigiani, sullo sfondo dell'Italia dal Dopoguerra agli anni 70. Dopo la fine del conflitto Gianni, Antonio e Nicola (Stefano Satta Flores) hanno preso strade diverse: Antonio fa il portantino e Nicola il professore, mentre Gianni è l’unico dei tre che è riuscito a fare carriera. Dopo molti anni, per caso, i tre si incontrano nuovamente. Sceneggiatura dello stesso Scola, con Age & Scarpelli, breve cameo di Vittorio De Sica, scomparso prima dell’uscita del film nelle sale.

programme.title: L'amore che non muore

programme.title: La migliore offerta
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige il premio Oscar Geoffrey Rush in un'intensa pellicola. La vita di un antiquario viene sconvolta dal segreto nascosto nei sotterranei di una villa.

programme.desc: Will Smith è la star di un commovente dramma sul dolore e la perdita. Segnato dalla morte della figlia, Howard, un pubblicitario di New York, si chiude in se stesso perdendo ogni interesse per cio' che lo circonda. L'unica sua reazione concreta consiste nella scrittura di lettere indirizzate alla Morte, al Tempo e all'Amore. Ai suoi amici non resta che assecondarlo mentre escogitano un piano per aiutarlo a riprendere in mano la propria vita. Dal regista de "Il diavolo veste Prada". Cast da tappeto rosso: Edward Norton, Keira Knightley, Naomie Harris e i premi Oscar Helen Mirren e Kate Winslet.

programme.title: Ogni maledetta domenica

Tony D'Amato e i suoi Miami Sharks perdono una partita dietro l'altra, il quarterback titolare e' fuori per infortunio e la giovane e affascinante proprietaria della squadra e' decisa a far fuori il coach. Ma mandarlo via non e' per nulla facile, la squadra e' con Tony e tra un problema e l'altro riesce a qualificarsi per i playoff. Dentro o fuori, non ci sono alternative.

programme.title: Gioia mia
programme.desc: Gioia, un'insegnante di letteratura francese, instaura un legame proibito, fragile e inspiegabilmente necessario con Alessio, un suo studente. Quest'ultimo però distrugge tutto e cancella l'unica persona che lo abbia mai amato.

programme.title: 2 gran figli di...

Peter e Kyle Reynolds sono due fratelli gemelli che si trovano, ormai adulti, davanti a una sconcertante verità: il loro padre biologico non è affatto morto ma nessuno, nemmeno la loro mamma Helen, ne conosce l'identità. Decidono quindi di attraversare gli Stati Uniti con la speranza di rintracciare l'uomo. Ma per farlo dovranno ascoltare tutte le avventure sessuali vissute dalla focosa e libertina Helen nei disinibiti anni Settanta. Nel cast i premi Oscar J.K. Simmons e Christopher Walken.

programme.title: Le amiche della sposa
programme.desc: Commedia di successo di Paul Feig con Kristen Wiig e Melissa McCarthy. Annie, damigella d'onore alle nozze della migliore amica Lilian, deve arginare le mosse astute delle altre ragazze.

programme.title: Ma cosa ci dice il cervello

programme.title: Il pesce innamorato
programme.desc: Tante risate insieme a Leonardo Pieraccioni e Paolo Hendel in una spensierata commedia sentimentale. Arturo e' un falegname diventato famoso grazie a un libro di fiabe. Durante uno dei numerosi viaggi per la promozione del suo best-seller, vive una notte di passione con la bellissima Matilde (la modella Yamila Diaz). Successivamente, stufo del peso del successo, decide di ritirarsi in una casa di legno nel bosco. Ma Matilde si rifa' viva molti mesi piu' tardi, con un neonato in braccio. La reazione dubbiosa di Arturo la spinge a fuggire per sposarsi con un altro uomo...

programme.title: Il ciclone
